name: Crispy Smoked Salmon Sandwich with Lemon Tartar Sauce & Side Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
½ bunch radish
1 tomato
1 avocado
1 head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemon into a small bowl (reserve lemon for later use).
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Mince capers; add to the bowl along with mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and pepper. Whisk to combine the tartar sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tbsp capers
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp white wine vinegar
Dijon mustard
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add smoked salmon slices to the skillet in a single layer; cook, flipping once, until crispy, about 4 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 (113 g) pkg smoked salmon

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice reserved lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey
⅛ tsp salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl.
Small dice half the tomato and add to the bowl. Thinly slice remaining tomato and place on a plate for serving.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh. Medium dice half the avocado and add to the bowl. Thinly slice remaining avocado and add to the plate with the sliced tomato; set aside.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 2 leaves per sandwich and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.

Place the bottom half of a roll on each plate. Layer with tartar sauce, lettuce, tomato, crispy smoked salmon, and avocado; close with the top half of each roll. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
